;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Terrorism in Saudi Arabia]]
**A bomb explodes at a [[Remembrance Day]] ceremony attended by foreign [[diplomat]]s in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]]. Several people are wounded. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-54889545 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Eta]] restrengthens into a [[category 1 hurricane]] as it reaches the [[Gulf Coast of the United States|Gulf Coast]] of [[Florida]]. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2020/11/11/weather/eta-storm-wednesday/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Texas]]
*****[[List of governors of Texas|Texas Governor]] [[Greg Abbott]] announces that the [[Texas|state]] is expected to deploy resources to [[Lubbock, Texas|Lubbock]] and [[El Paso, Texas|El Paso]] to help combat the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.fox34.com/gov-abbott-deploys-additional-covid-19-resources-to-lubbock-el-paso/article_6ab4ddc4-2473-11eb-9ecc-97c705e0cc2b.html (KJTV-TV)]
*****[[El Paso County, Texas|El Paso County]] judge Ricardo Samaniego announces that the stay-at-home order will be extended to December 1 as cases continue to increase. [https://elpasoheraldpost.com/el-paso-county-judge-stay-at-home-order-is-extended-though-december-1st/ (''El Paso Herald-Post'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arkansas]]
*****[[Arkansas]] reports 1,962 new cases, a new single-day record. [https://www.ky3.com/2020/11/11/state-of-arkansas-sets-daily-record-for-covid-19-cases-governor-says-plan-holidays-safely/ (KYTV-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Illinois]] reports 12,657 new infections, a new single-day record as the number of hospitalized patients reaches an all-time high of 5,042, surpassing the previous record set in April. [https://chicago.cbslocal.com/2020/11/11/coronavirus-in-illinois-another-record-for-new-covid-19-cases-as-hospitalizations-hit-all-time-mark/ (WBBM-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] announces a 10:00 p.m. [[Eastern Time Zone|EST]] curfew for bars, restaurants, and gyms in the [[New York (state)|state]] from November 13 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://patch.com/new-york/new-york-city/bars-restaurants-get-10-p-m-curfew-amid-coronavirus-rise-cuomo (Patch.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Carolina]]
*****[[North Carolina]] reports 3,119 new cases in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record, as the positivity rate rises to 7.9%. [https://www.wcnc.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/nc-sets-a-new-record-covid-19-record-high-its-not-even-thanksgiving-yet/275-818d8593-8b57-4297-a70b-4313e1161700 (WCNC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
*****[[Governor of Ohio|Ohio Governor]] [[Mike DeWine]] reinstates a statewide [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] with penalties for businesses. He also says that the [[Ohio|state]] might close restaurants, bars, and fitness centers if cases continue to increase. [https://www.wdtn.com/news/ohio/dewine-revises-mask-mandate-adds-penalties-for-non-complaint-businesses/ (WDTN)] [https://www.cleveland.com/open/2020/11/gov-mike-dewine-is-reissuing-statewide-mask-order-with-new-provisions-saying-ohio-is-in-a-third-wave-of-the-coronavirus.html (Cleveland.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vermont]]
*****[[Vermont]] reports 72 new cases, a new single-day record since the [[pandemic]] began. [https://vtdigger.org/2020/11/11/vermont-breaks-its-record-for-single-day-covid-case-count-state-prepares-for-surge/ (VTDigger)]
****The number of people who hospitalised due to [[COVID-19]] in the [[United States]] reaches 65,368, a new record for second day a row. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/covid-19-surge-strains-hospitals-once-again-11605100312 (''Wall Street Journal'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 1,426 new infections, a new single-day record. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/covid-19-coronavirus-ontario-november-11-record-1.5798139 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports 261 new fatalities, according to the [[Robert Koch Institute]]. This is the highest number of deaths in a single day since April, raising the nationwide death toll to 11,767. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/germany-sees-highest-virus-deaths-since-april/2039986 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
**** The [[Government of Greece|Greek government]] announces that it will impose a nationwide overnight curfew from 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. local time, beginning November 13. This comes as the [[National Public Health Organization (Greece)|National Public Health Organization]] reports a record 2,752 new cases and 43 deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://www.thenationalherald.com/archive_general_news_greece/arthro/greece_imposes_stricker_covid_restrictions_as_deaths_break_daily_record-1187744/ (''The National Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] surpasses one million total COVID-19 cases, becoming the third country in the [[European Union]] to surpass that milestone. In addition, the country also reports 623 new deaths, the highest single-day total since April 6. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/11/italy-passes-1m-covid-cases-as-calls-grow-for-national-lockdown (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports 432 new fatalities in the last 24 hours, raising its nationwide death toll to 31,593. It is first time that the country has reported more than 400 deaths and is also a new single-day record for that figure since the pandemic began. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/11/11/russia-sees-record-one-day-coronavirus-deaths-a72011 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****The number of deaths from COVID-19 in [[Spain]] surpasses 40,000. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2020-11-spain-covid-death-toll.html (Medical Xpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] announces a nationwide indoor smoking ban in a bid to halt the rising number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-introduces-smoking-ban-to-curb-virus-infections/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports 50,385 total COVID-19 deaths since the start of the pandemic, becoming the first country in [[Europe]] to surpass 50,000 deaths. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-54905018 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] reports the first domestic case of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] from a truck driver who infected his wife and two other relatives after three weeks of [[quarantine]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20201111-mongolia-reports-first-domestic-coronavirus-transmissions (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports a record 11,780 new infections and 462 fatalities in the past 24 hours, raising its nationwide totals since the beginning of the pandemic to 715,068 cases and 39,664 deaths. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran-idUSKBN27R1BQ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] reports 1,708 new infections in the last 24 hours, which is the highest daily total since August as it considers new measures to combat the rising number of cases. [https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/world/sudden-spurt-in-coronavirus-cases-in-pakistan-169319 (''Tribune India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] surpasses 400,000 total COVID-19 cases, becoming the second country in [[Southeast Asia]] after [[Indonesia]] to reach that milestone. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2020/11/11/2056163/coronavirus-cases-philippines-top-400000-death-toll-7710 (Philstar)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vanuatu]]
***[[Vanuatu]] reports its first case of COVID-19 after a citizen who was repatriated from the [[United States]] tested positive while in quarantine. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2020-11-11/covid-free-pacific-nation-vanuatu-first-case-coronavirus/12871860 (ABC Australia)]

;International relations
*[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]; [[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
***The [[Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore]] (CAAS) announces that a "travel bubble" between [[Singapore]] and [[Hong Kong]] will begin on November 22 with 200 passengers per day. Passengers on these flights will not be subjected to a two-week quarantine. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/hong-kong-air-travel-bubble-covid-19-flights-singapore-13513966 (CNA)]
*[[Philippines–United States relations]]
**[[Secretary of Foreign Affairs (Philippines)|Philippine Foreign Secretary]] [[Teodoro Locsin Jr.]] announces [[Government of the Philippines|the government]]'s decision to suspend the termination of the [[Philippines–United States Visiting Forces Agreement|Visiting Forces Agreement with the United States]] for at least another six months. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2020/11/da929925831b-corrected-philippines-to-keep-suspending-move-to-scrap-military-pact-with-us.html (Kyodo News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2020 Reading stabbings]]
**Kahairi Saadallah pleads guilty to three [[murder in English law|murders]] and three [[attempted murder]]s. [https://telegraph.co.uk/news/2020/11/11/reading-terror-attacker-pleads-guilty-three-murders/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Belizean general election]]
**A [[Elections in Belize|general election]] is held in [[Belize]] amidst a prolonged economic crisis. [[Patrick Faber (politician)|Patrick Faber]] of the ruling [[United Democratic Party (Belize)|United Democratic Party]] is challenged by [[Johnny Briceño]], the candidate of the oppositional [[People's United Party]]. [[Dean Barrow]], [[Prime Minister of Belize]] for the past 12 years, decided to not run again for office. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/11/belize-electing-new-government-amid-rising-coronavirus-cases (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Politics of Bahrain]]
**Prince and [[Prime Minister of Bahrain|Prime Minister]] [[Khalifa bin Salman Al Khalifa]] dies at the age of 84 after holding the office since 1970. He is succeeded by Prince [[Salman, Crown Prince of Bahrain|Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/11/bahrain-pm-has-died-royal-palace-says (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019–20 Hong Kong protests]]; [[Legislative Council of Hong Kong]]
**Four [[Hong Kong]] [[pro-democracy]] activists, [[Alvin Yeung]], [[Dennis Kwok]], [[Kwok Ka-ki]] and [[Kenneth Leung]], are stripped of their seats following a decision by China's [[National People's Congress Standing Committee]]. 15 pro-democracy legislators announced their resignations shortly after the announcement, also declaring "that '[[One Country, Two Systems]]' has come to an end". Critics fear this will turn the legislature into a rubber stamp for pro-Beijing policies. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/11/asia/hong-kong-lawmakers-unseated-china-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/11/china-pro-democracy-hong-kong-lawmakers-opposition-oust (''The Guardian'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
**Several officers are injured after [[far-right]] protestors clash with [[Policja (Poland)|police]] in [[Warsaw]], after thousands defied public gathering restrictions to participate in the annual [[National Independence Day (Poland)|Independence Day]] march. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/11/far-right-hooligans-clash-with-police-at-warsaw-march (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Presidential transition of Joe Biden]]
**[[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] announces [[Ron Klain]] as his incoming [[White House Chief of Staff]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/11/11/politics/biden-chief-of-staff/index.html (CNN)]
